# Participant declarations and need attribution

Execution and Operating Model documents are to declare, near the start, the human and agent types, roles or groups used in their descriptions, with enough information to distinguish them. Attribute needs to the participants or groups whose desired conditions they express, so different needs and potential trade-offs are visible.

Apply this through the [participant-declaration authoring guidance](../../standard/application/problem-context-and-actor-language.md#declare-participants-and-attribute-needs). The detailed role/group distinctions, requirement-origin representation and trade-off proposal remain under development; this decision does not adopt a universal score or resolve a particular conflict.
